# Atributos data-cro-* Type: Kit extra. A feature Bootstrap does not have. Section: Extras do kit Human version (rendered examples): extras/atributos-data.html Prose language: Brazilian Portuguese. Code, class names and identifier tables are language-neutral. cro-* / is-* classes in this page: cro-progress cro-progress__bar cro-tab-panels cro-tabs cro-tabs__btn is-active data-cro-* attributes in this page: data-cro-color data-cro-panel data-cro-panels data-cro-select data-cro-tab data-cro-tabs Os atributos HTML que controlam comportamento do kit, sem JavaScript seu. | Atributo | Onde | Faz | | data-cro-tabs | contêiner dos botões de aba | Liga as abas ARIA do kit | | data-cro-panels="#seletor" | junto de data-cro-tabs | Indica onde estão os painéis | | data-cro-tab="id" | botão da aba | Aponta o painel | | data-cro-panel="id" | painel | Identifica o painel | | data-cro-select | …
``` Estes atributos têm tudo a ver com o JS do kit; veja JavaScript. « Tokens (variáveis CSS) · Índice de classes cro-* »
